🔐 Security & Sharing

Protect the configuration with a password, then generate a locked copy of this tool to hand out. Anyone who opens that copy can use the tool but can’t change the setup without the password.

Downloads a self-contained HTML with your current configuration and password baked in. Share that file — recipients land on the User side and can’t edit configuration.

Editable Lines · Before → After60 rules

Edit modes — Change number: locates the line by an identifier (e.g. N06750) using starts with / contains / is exactly, then changes only the number after a marker (e.g. the number after P, occurrence #) to your After value — the rest of the user's line is left untouched, so small template differences don't matter. For 8-digit on/off values like 00000000, switch Change to specific bits and click any bits 0–7 to cycle each one keep → 1 → 0 (bit 7 is the leftmost digit, bit 0 the rightmost). You can set several bits in one rule; bits left on "keep" stay as they are in the user's file. Whole line · by param: matches the user's line by its first token and replaces the entire line with After. Whole line · exact: only changes a line matching the entire Before text exactly. Use Verify to preview every rule against the loaded base template. To change more than one number on the same line, add a separate rule for each (use the ⧉ duplicate button on a rule, then change its marker/occurrence) — the rules apply together, one after another, to that line.

🛡 Run Requirements (Guards)

Conditions the loaded file must satisfy. If any requirement fails, the tool refuses to run and tells the user why. Each one locates a line, reads a number out of it, and checks it against a value you set. These are per-scenario.

How extraction works — the guard finds the line (by starts with / contains / exact), then reads the number that follows the marker text. For a line like N06750Q1L1P69886L2P0L3P0L4P0, identifier N06750 with marker P and occurrence 1 reads 69886; occurrence 2 reads the next P value. Leave the marker blank to read the Nth standalone number on the line. If a base template is loaded above, each requirement shows a live preview against it.
